summary: First iteration end-to-end test of Basket Scout Sheet Pro. Backend (8 pytest cases) and Frontend (Playwright, tablet-landscape 1366x900) both PASSED. Covered: matches CRUD, rosters CRUD, SSE AI analysis stream + persistence, new-match dialog, scoreboard inline edit, venue toggle, roster 5-In-Campo badge, court shot capture (made 2pt / missed / made 3pt), FT made/missed, opponent points, global undo (reverted -3 opp correctly), stat +/- counters with floor-at-0, autosave 'Salvato' indicator, Report tab (boxscore + shot map + charts + quarter badges), Dati partita fields persisting, reload persistence of scores, save & re-list roster from home, delete match with confirm dialog, delete roster. AI analysis streamed 1693 chars of Italian Markdown in ~30s and persisted on reload.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description or aria-describedby (a11y console warning, non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription/> or aria-describedby to NewMatchDialog and SaveRosterDialog to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_matches reads full match docs then rebuilds Pydantic model to compute score - fine at current scale but consider pre-storing computed scores if list grows large.
No concurrency/version guard on PUT /api/matches/{id}: last write wins. Acceptable for single-user scouting but could overwrite in multi-tab scenario.
ScoutPage autosave debounce 600ms is sensible; however analysis endpoint overwrites ai_analysis even if the SSE connection is cancelled mid-stream, leaving a partial report. Minor.
frontend/.env lacks a .env.example; env is still correct.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed matches and rosters and clean them up via fixtures / UI delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (8 tests incl. SSE AI analysis) runs in ~9s. Public URL testing uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All data-testids present and reliable. One leftover non-TEST match 'Castel Gandolfo vs Pavona' and 'Olimpia vs Virtus' exist as sample data - don't delete.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. During initial run a test-side assertion compared pre-FT score (5) to post-reload score (7) and falsely reported mismatch; after re-verification the score was correctly 7 both before and after reload, confirming autosave + reload persistence works.
